resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 579 ft (176 m); Tennessee Landforms lists 588 ft. The story reports both and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, staffing or fire history in any source read, so the story is short. The NHLR gives no access level; 'active TN Forestry site' is the only access clue, so facts.access is omitted. Sources: NHLR entry (site visit 1/28/23), Tennessee Landforms table (standing, 8-3), and the NPS-hosted Tennessee Division of Forestry MPS (extant list, March 26, 2014; LS-40 usage). Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 4 page reads.
